Zakspeed BMW Team: Erich Zakowski's team from Niederzissen. Raced Fords until 1986. Runs BMW's junior team with two new M3s in 1987.
Ford Ringshausen Motorsport: Ford Sierra XR4Ti team. Manuel Reuter gets one of the first Sierra RS 500 Cosworth cars from round 9.
BMW Isert: BMW M3 team. Olaf Manthey and Josef Gerold drive in 1987.
IPS Motorsport: Volvo 240 Turbo team from Sweden. Per Stureson won the 1985 title with a Volvo.
Kamei Crew: Kurt König's team. Starts the year with a BMW 635 CSi and also races a BMW M3.
AC München: BMW 635 CSi team from Munich. Anton Goeser drives in 1987.
AMG Marko RSM: Mercedes 190E 2.3-16 team with three cars, built with AMG from Affalterbach.
Private entries: Private drivers who enter their own cars.
Wolf Racing: Ford Sierra team. Joachim Winkelhock and Frank Biela drive in 1987. Gets the Sierra RS 500 Cosworth late in the year.
Alpina: BMW tuner from Buchloe. Has raced BMW touring cars since the 1960s.
Gubin-Sport: BMW 635 CSi team. Volker Strycek won the first title in 1984.
Müller-Bräu Team: BMW 635 CSi team. Fritz Müller drives in 1987.
Sachs Sporting: Jürgen Weiler starts the year in a Mercedes 190E and switches to a BMW M3.
